title: Estimating Average Treatment Effects with Projected Instrumental Variables
abstract: arXiv:2611.00705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we develop a projected instrumental variable framework that relaxes conventional assumptions for causal identification with instrumental variables. Building on the interpretation of conditional expectation as an orthogonal projection in a Hilbert space, the framework replaces the conditional expectation operator with a general projection operator. We provide an alternative inverse problem formulation based on the Riesz representation. Drawing on semiparametric efficiency theory, we further develop debiased and adaptive machine learning methods for estimation and inference. The proposed framework connects invalid instrumental variables to instrumented difference-in-differences. We also examine invalid projected instrumental variables and discuss their relationship to existing methods. Simulation studies and real data analysis demonstrate that the proposed methods perform favorably compared with existing approaches.

translated_title: 基于投影工具变量的平均处理效应估计
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个投影工具变量框架，该框架放宽了使用工具变量进行因果识别的常规假设。基于将条件期望解释为希尔伯特空间中的正交投影，该框架用一般的投影算子替代了条件期望算子。我们基于Riesz表示提供了一种替代性的逆问题表述。借鉴半参数有效性理论，我们进一步开发了用于估计和推断的去偏和自适应机器学习方法。所提出的框架将无效工具变量与工具化双重差分方法联系起来。我们还研究了无效的投影工具变量，并讨论了它们与现有方法的关系。模拟研究和真实数据分析表明，所提出的方法与现有方法相比表现良好。
tldr: 本文提出投影工具变量框架，通过将条件期望算子推广为一般投影算子来放宽工具变量因果识别的常规假设，并结合半参数效率理论开发了去偏的自适应机器学习估计与推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a projected instrumental variable framework that relaxes conventional causal identification assumptions by replacing the conditional expectation operator with a general projection operator, and develops debiased adaptive machine learning methods for estimation and inference grounded in semiparametric efficiency theory.
